system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Avemakes planner prompts learnable, uses invariant violations and runtime per-formance as reward signals, and applies text gradients [74] to improve subsequent optimization plans.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper only. Planner prompt is rewritten each round by ParameterUpdate (LLM text-gradient), which is closer to model_generated. Retrieved knowledge and history are also composed in. Ambiguity between dynamically_composed and model_generated.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Retrievefilters them by the request, GPU, and current ker-nel to produce𝐾𝑡.
env_context_strategy.note: Knowledge-base retrieval is filtered by request, GPU and kernel. The retrieval mechanism is unspecified; closest value chosen. Codex runtime may also navigate.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: The harness periodically compacts the feedback history.
context_compaction.note: The compaction mechanism is unspecified. Retaining summaries of prior candidates suggests summarize.

observation_format.note: Feedback is textual witnesses and profiles.

tool_call_format.note: Codex is the runtime, but the paper does not describe the tool-call format. No repo was available.

tool_count.note: No tool registry is in the evidence.

edit_primitive.note: The edit tool is not described. The Codex runtime is implied.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency or source listing was available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: In each round, a plan-ner proposes optimization candidates, a selector constructs an ordered plan, and a lowering agent implements it. Only a measured speedup replaces the current kernel.
loop_primitives.note: Algorithm 1 runs a fixed planner, select, lower, validate and profile sequence per round. Validation feedback drives the next round.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Selectorders compatible proposals into𝑎𝑡 =(𝑎 𝑡,1,...,𝑎 𝑡,𝑚𝑡).

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a plan-ner proposes optimization candidates, a selector constructs an ordered plan, and a lowering agent implements it.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Lowerinvokes the lowering agent to apply every optimization in 𝑎𝑡 to𝑠★.
delegation_mechanism.note: Handoff between planner and lowering agent. Whether a new conversation is spawned is unstated.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: In round𝑡, it observes𝑥𝑡 =⟨𝑞,𝑠 ★,𝐾𝑡,𝐹⟩ : the best kernel 𝑠★, retrieved knowledge 𝐾𝑡, and feedback history𝐹.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: The knowledge base  contains auditable, expert-curated hardware facts, DSL references, and optimization recipes.
long_term_memory.note: The KB is fixed and curated, not written across runs. The planner prompt is benchmark-local.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Validation compiles this candidate, checks every generated invariant (the set may be empty), and runs unit tests.
self_verification.note: SMT-checked data-flow invariants (Z3) are coded formal. The paper states they are not full proofs. Closest value chosen.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: We runAve, KernelFalcon, KSearch, and CUDA-Forge for up to ten optimization trials

rollback.evidence_quote: retains the fastest candidate that passes auto-mated invariant checks and unit tests.
rollback.note: The best kernel s★ is kept, and failing candidates are discarded. Closest value chosen.

tracing.evidence_quote: The replay record stores the planner input𝑥𝑡, candidate record𝑓𝑡, validation outcomes𝐶𝑡,𝐴𝑡,𝑉𝑡, and𝑈𝑡, performance term Δ𝑡, and re-ward𝑅𝑡.

replayability.note: A 'replay record' exists for ICRL, but no re-run facility is described.

eval_hooks.note: The paper evaluates on KernelBench, but no repo was available to check for a built-in runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Data-flow invariants additionally reject shortcuts that violate declared use-site relationships.

target_domain.evidence_quote: an agentic framework for automating complex, multilevel GPU kernel optimizations.
target_domain.note: GPU kernel optimization. It is code-related but not repository SWE.

open_source.note: The licence file was not seen.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: We evaluate all agentic frameworks with GPT-5.6 Sol (GPT) [55], DeepSeek V4 Pro (DSv4) [23], and DeepSeek V4 Flash (DSv4F) [23]

primary_artifact.note: Only the paper (arXiv 2604.18616v2) was available. The repo exists but was not in the evidence.
